commit_message: Renderer: align IBL bake uniform layout
pr_body:
## Summary
- add renderer-owned diffuse irradiance, GGX specular prefilter, and split-sum BRDF LUT generation
- feed generic StandardLit indirect lighting from existing EnvironmentLighting runtime texture IDs without changing material/scene/Stable ID contracts
- render a resolved equirectangular skybox as the scene background and preserve procedural-sky fallback
- keep AO scoped to StandardLit indirect light
- keep mesh pipelines within the portable four-bind-group floor
- align the IBL precompute uniform with the 16-byte CPU payload and keep the fixed-camera GPU regression
- record the renderer-owned IBL contract in ADR 0122
